contentPattern.structure: one row per item: label cell (question/title) + body cell (answer)

variants.name: accordion
variants.description: Base FAQ. Two-column grid at 992px, single-open, rotating chevron. 1px #eee top divider per item; label 20px/700 (18px mobile); body 16px.

variants.name: downloads
variants.description: Body is a list of document/download links styled as green (#008542) bold underlined links, single column, multi-open.

variants.name: table-docs
variants.description: Body contains a specs table (th 50% bold + td value, 1px #eee row dividers) plus document links; larger 24px label on desktop, single column, multi-open.
